tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier that owns this key

name.description: Human-readable label for the API key

allowed_models.description: List of model identifiers this key may access

rate_limit_rps.description: Maximum requests per second allowed for this key

burst_size.description: Burst capacity above the steady-state RPS limit

tokens_per_min.description: Maximum LLM tokens per minute for this key

enabled.description: Whether the API key is active. Absent = enabled (optional, nullable to distinguish unset).
